about_pullquote: A car lockout shouldn't cost you a fortune or half your day waiting.
about_para_1: Car Key Doc was founded over a decade ago by a former dealership technician frustrated by the high costs and long waits customers faced when keys went missing or locks failed. What started as a one-van operation has grown into Nottingham's go-to emergency car key service, handling over 1,000 lockouts and key replacements every year. We've invested in the latest key-cutting and programming equipment so we can help you on the roadside, not force you to the dealership.
about_para_2: Our reputation is built on speed and honesty — we quote upfront, arrive within 45 minutes, and charge fair prices for a job that's done right. We work with vehicle owners, courier firms, and local businesses who know they can rely on us when they're in a tight spot. Most of our new customers come from recommendations, because once you've used us, you tend to tell your friends.
reviews_heading: What Nottingham Drivers Say About Car Key Doc

reviews.text: Locked my keys in the car outside work in town. Called Car Key Doc and they were with me in less than 40 minutes. New key cut and programmed on the spot. Absolute lifesaver — and honestly cheaper than what the dealership quoted. Will use them again if I ever have to.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: My partner broke her ignition key right in the lock. Could have been a nightmare, but the lad came out, got the broken bit out safely, and had a working key cut within an hour. Professional, friendly, and he didn't try to upsell us on stuff we didn't need. Top marks.
reviews.author: Rebecca S.

reviews.text: Had a van full of tools and locked the keys inside. Called on a Sunday evening, fully expecting a huge callout fee. They came out promptly, got us open, and the bill was reasonable. Can't ask for more than that really. Brilliant service.
reviews.author: David M.
